label: Social audio platform
summary: A social audio platform is an online space where people gather in live audio rooms to talk, listen, and interact. Clubhouse is the specific example that appears in Maaike's work, characterised as a social audio platform. It functions as a venue for community building around shared interests.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike uses Clubhouse as a gathering place for the conversation design community. She set up a dedicated club called Convoclub and runs weekly Friday rooms where conversation designers, linguists, bot builders, and language lovers can chat casually, discuss their weeks, and hear from guests in the conversational space. She also plans to sketchnote each session, tying her visual practice into the audio format.
open_questions: How sustainable the weekly Convoclub rhythm turned out to be is not addressed in the available material.
Whether Maaike eventually moved these community conversations to a different platform as social audio fell in and out of fashion is left open.
